mistakes.class: unscored conjunct — the predicate's 'pristine 29 cases' and 'm03/m05/m08 detected by that one case alone' are written into the receipt (`pristine.cases`, `sole_detector`) and read by neither `receipt['ok']` nor `validate_receipt`; a forged receipt with `cases 1` or with m03 killed by three cases returns `defects []`.

mistakes.class: undeclared precedence — `parse_record` resolves a repeated client pin last-wins (dict comprehension) and a repeated Ghidra/.bashrc cell first-wins (`re.search`); a record keeping a superseded cell above the live one binds the superseded cell.
mistakes.evidence: `tools/round-79/pointer-bind.py:127,138,147`; `proofs.txt` section B (`Kimi :4126` then `:4722` binds `:4722`; `.bashrc:23-24` then `:28-29` binds the stale `:23-24`); `PROVINCE.md:27` precedes the historical `.bashrc:63-69` at `:28`, so the freeze passes on document order.

mistakes.class: vacuous floor — `ok` requires `len(results) == 5` but `parse_record` always emits five checks (three clients incl. placeholders, one Ghidra, one .bashrc), so the floor cannot fail and a six-cell record is silently truncated; `bind()`'s `line_count` parameter is never read (0 and 999 behave identically; the bound is `len(lines)`).
mistakes.evidence: `tools/round-79/pointer-bind.py:79,123-157,205`; `proofs.txt` section C (empty record -> 5 checks, all unparsed; six-cell record -> 5 checks, one dropped) and D (line_count 0 vs 999 identical; past-end message uses len(lines)).
mistakes.fix: `cells_present` counted from the record's bytes before collapse must equal `checks_total`, and a declared-but-dropped cell is `unparsed`; delete `line_count` or make it authoritative; selftests `red-extra-cell-dropped`, `red-line-count-mismatch`.

mistakes.class: context-bound receipt — `.ufo/waves/round-79/pre/selftest-gate.txt` carries the 29-case tally and no rev, path or digest (zero 8+-hex tokens); its link to the declaration's instrument is external (blob at a1f9b81c hashes to the pin 4e4baf00..., re-run byte-identical).
mistakes.fix: open the tally with `rev=<40hex> target=<path> sha256=<64hex>` (or JSON with those fields) and refuse a receipt without them; the test is declared digest == blob digest at the declared rev.
